ValidationRule.description: Number required if isPostalNumeric is true
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsPostalNumeric__c = TRUE, OR ( ISNUMBER(PostcodeFrom__c) = FALSE, ISNUMBER(PostcodeTo__c) = FALSE, PostcodeFrom__c > PostcodeTo__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: PostcodeFrom and PostcodeTo required if the rule is numeric
